description: This file contains the implementation of the MySQLi database driver class within the Opencart system, providing methods for connecting to the database, executing queries, escaping strings, and managing the database connection lifecycle.

classes.name: MySQLi
classes.description: Class that provides MySQL database connection and query functionality using the MySQLi extension, supporting SSL connections, query execution, escaping, and connection management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new database connection with optional SSL support based on provided credentials and configuration.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result, either as fetched data or as a boolean for non-select statements.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string to make it safe for use in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID generated by the last insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the database connection is currently established.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
